journeyGroups.why: Why now: Emily completed a dated Vacation submission that created a pending request and navigated to My leave, while an empty-date submission was client-side blocked. Observations: 5, 10, and 15 for Emily.dawson.

scenarios.gherkin:
Given Emily.dawson is on the New leave request form
When she submits the form without a start date and an end date
Then the form remains displayed with the message Please fill in all required fields.
scenarios.name: Require leave dates before submission

scenarios.gherkin:
Given Emily.dawson is on the New leave request form
And Vacation is selected with start date 2026-09-15 and end date 2026-09-16
When she submits the request
Then My leave shows a pending Vacation request for 2 days
scenarios.name: Submit a dated Vacation leave request

journeyGroups.why: Why now: The first approval action opened a confirmation, and final approval made Emily request 3 approved and removed it from pending approvals. Observations: 31, 37, and 43 for michael.reed.

scenarios.gherkin:
Given michael.reed is viewing a pending Vacation request for Emily.dawson dated 2026-09-15 through 2026-09-16 in Manager approvals
When he selects Approve and confirms approval
Then the request is approved and no longer appears in pending approvals
scenarios.name: Confirm approval of a pending employee leave request
